title: Determinant-one real Möbius maps preserve the pseudohyperbolic ratio norm
statement: Let a,b,c,d be real numbers satisfying ad−bc=1, and let z,v∈ℂ satisfy Im(z)>0 and Im(v)>0. Define the total complex function M(x)=(ax+b)/(cx+d), with real coefficients embedded in ℂ. Then ‖(M(z)−M(v))/(M(z)−conj(M(v)))‖=‖(z−v)/(z−conj(v))‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (z v : ℂ), a * d - b * c = 1 → 0 < z.im → 0 < v.im → let M : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => ((a : ℂ) * x + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * x + (d : ℂ)); ‖(M z - M v) / (M z - star (M v))‖ = ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖
